image_description: A full suit of Japanese-style armor (O-yoroi or similar) displayed on a stand. It features a helmet (kabuto) with a face mask (menpo), layered scale armor (kozane) in gold and dark tones, and fabric components in deep red/maroon. The chest area consists of overlapping scales rather than a single solid plate.
